comments.body:
Reviewed the full solution against problem rm-08457 (autonomous + nonautonomous Nicholson blowflies, parts (i)-(iii)). The proof is essentially complete and rigorous. I numerically verified every load-bearing claim:

1. Contraction Lemma: |G(x)-N*|<|x-N*| for all x>0, x!=N* holds iff N*<2; confirmed across N* in {0.5,...,3.0}.
2. Interval-iteration (envelope) collapse to {N*} for N*<2; and confirmed it GENUINELY fails at N*=2 (the iteration stalls at a nondegenerate invariant interval since |G'(N*)|=|1-N*|=1). So Theorem 1's strict requirement N*<2 is correct and not improvable by this envelope method.
3. Characteristic-equation critical values s_c, omega_c for N*>2 satisfy the characteristic equation at lambda=i*omega_c to machine precision.
4. For N*>2, a right-half-plane root exists for EVERY s>s_c (checked over wide ranges and several N*), confirming Prop. nec-auto(b) and its use in Prop. nec-nonauto.
5. At N*=2 the rightmost characteristic root -> 0^- as s->infty (marginal stability), NOT instability.

FIXES APPLIED:
(a) The Remark after Theorem 1 overstated the boundary case ('at N*=2 local stability fails for large delay'). N*=2 is in fact marginal (roots approach but do not cross the imaginary axis). I rewrote it to state precisely that for N*>2 stability fails once delay exceeds s_c, while N*=2 is the marginal boundary where both the characteristic roots and the envelope method just fail (|G'(N*)|=1).
(b) Corrected 'N*>=2' to 'N*>2' in Corollary (ii) so the instability assertion matches Prop. nec-auto(b), which requires N*>2 strictly.

Brace/environment balance verified (no LaTeX toolchain available to compile). No remaining mathematical gaps identified; parts (i), (ii), (iii) are established.
